summary: An OpenAI researcher states that the computational depth of current frontier models, including a model called Astra, is within a factor of two of GPT-4, and that OpenAI has worked to preserve chain-of-thought monitorability.

practices.reason: The post describes an internal lab effort to preserve and use chain-of-thought monitoring as a safety-relevant measurement practice, but gives no transferable method.
